items.quote: Frist: ein Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter states it was posted (zur Post gegeben) on 30.03.2026. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a tax letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. 03.04.2026 (Friday). That day is Karfreitag (Good Friday), a public holiday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO delivery is deemed to occur on the next working day, Tuesday 07.04.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) runs from 07.04.2026 and ends one month later, on Thursday 07.05.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). That day is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies. Confirmed via the compute_deadline tool.
